description: Official-style portrait photograph of Mario Monti, elderly Italian economist-statesman with grey hair and glasses, dark suit, neutral background.
Mobutu Sese Seko in military uniform wearing his trademark leopardskin cap, holding a carved walking stick, 1970s photograph style.
Black-and-white presidential portrait photograph of James A. Garfield, bearded, 1881.
Mayor Richard J. Daley speaking forcefully at a podium with microphones, Chicago, 1960s black-and-white press photo.
Charles Taylor, Canadian philosopher, elderly man with white hair, speaking at a university lecture.
Clean sociological diagram showing arrows of upward and downward movement between social class layers (intergenerational mobility flows).
Bar/line chart showing share of total wealth held by the top 1% versus the bottom 50% in selected countries, academic style.
The 1892 Punch cartoon The Rhodes Colossus: Cecil Rhodes as a giant straddling Africa from Cape Town to Cairo holding a telegraph line.
